Get a summary of the deployment for a Cribl product.

Get a summary of the deployment for the specified Cribl product (Stream or Edge). The summary includes a count of Worker Groups or Edge Fleets and resources such as Pipelines, Routes, Sources, and Destinations. For Distributed deployments, the summary also includes a count and statistics for Worker or Edge Nodes.
